integrity: Analytic proof of a sharp quantified claim; exact symbolic calculations independently replayable; not independently audited.
scientific_limitations: Restricted to IID uniform with-replacement sampling, identical SPD quadratic components, fixed scalar stepsize, and convergence in mean square from arbitrary deterministic initial state; no result for heterogeneous or nonquadratic components.
title: Sharp all-sample-count mean-square stability of SAG on identical SPD quadratics
